clips.title: The story
paras: Kinelory is ready to head down to the farm and wants you at her side. She fears the undead may be doing harm back in Hillsbrad the longer they wait, and you are asked to see her safely back to Quae.

After the earlier steps of the investigation, Kinelory is ready to act. She asks you to come with her down to the farm. You are to see her safely back to Quae, and anyone who cares about the people of Hillsbrad is urged to protect her.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All right, friend. I'm ready if you are.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The time for talk is done. Protect Kinelory if you care about the people of Hillsbrad at all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done a great service for us, friend. Thank you.
I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
